marketing_objective: Generate legitimate awareness, enquiries, qualified leads and completed orders for configured products and services.
rules: Never invent prices, discounts, stock levels or delivery charges.
Do not make unsupported medical or health claims.
Do not spam customers or prospects.
Respect customer consent and opt-out requests.
Do not guarantee sales or results.
Keep promotional information consistent with the current product database.
Record campaign performance where data is available.
